blob.description: The file as it will be posted: a photo already compressed to the PDS's image limits, or the video Bluesky's video service stored.

exif.description: Camera data in app.zeens.postMeta#exif's shape. Never a location.

name.description: The file's name on the author's device, so they can tell their uploads apart.

post.description: The post this was published (or scheduled) in. Absent while unpublished.

postedAt.description: When the post goes out: now, or a scheduled post's publishAt.

paletteShares.description: Each swatch's share of the frame, as app.zeens.postMeta's paletteShares.

main.description: One photo or video in the author's media library (My media): uploaded, not yet part of a post. Lives on the author's own PDS and keeps its blob referenced until it is posted or deleted. Carries what was read from the file at upload — camera data and colours — and nothing a post decides (caption, location, categories). NOT PRIVATE: like every repo record it is publicly readable. Deliberately absent from the AppView's lexicons and firehose collections, so it is never indexed as content.
